column1: # ADR-0001's one table: every tracked-or-generated artifact under the asset roots,
# with its provenance and — for disc derivations — the generator that writes it.
# iso-data / iso-code        rebuilt by bootstrap_assets.sh; MUST NOT be committed.
# runtime-capture            only observable in a running engine; committed.
# fftpatcher                 from FFTPatcher's open-source data, not Square's disc.
# hand-authored              a person wrote it (or merge-authored it over a derivation).
# .gitignore's managed block is rendered from this file; tools/check_generated_assets.py
# fails if the two disagree. See root docs/adr/0001.
